text:
The the people who are easily offended. You can't stop the best morimens player from doing whatever he wants. He'll get past all your defenses. He made Counter work in Madness. He is the person Light proclaimed made counter viable. There is nothing you can do to stop him frok going into your home and taking all your possessions. He'll just rewind. If he was in the Avengers? Thanos stood no chance, he'd go over more futures than the Sorcerer Supreme himself. Again. This was like 8+ HOURS after the dtide where I saw this and his ONLY CLEAR. At the time. So you believe he either took 8 -11 hours. OR He's just that good and just started d-tide. 

I believe powercreep is coming faster. Look at JP corpo. If its not % dmg, its DR. I belive lvl 100 units are coming. Because last time they did this, they introduced lvl 90 to help players clear. That'll be the same here. Which would fix some units. But at that point, why invest in pure dmg. When the answer to not be powercrept is % dmg.
